INSERT INTO stremio_accounts (id, user_id, email, auth_key)
        VALUES ($1, NULL, $2, $3)
        ON CONFLICT ((user_id IS NULL)) WHERE user_id IS NULL
        DO UPDATE SET email = EXCLUDED.email, auth_key = EXCLUDED.auth_key,
                      last_error = NULL, updated_at = NOW()
        RETURNING id
